end.summary: Defined physical change using melting, shaping, and dissolving examples.
end.parentNote: Ananya practised identifying physical and chemical changes using evidence such as a new substance, colour or smell change, gas, heat, light, and a new solid. They explained melting ghee or wax, shaping aluminium, and cutting paper as physical changes, and identified burning and souring milk as chemical changes. The method of using evidence rather than reversibility was practised, but the reversibility mix-up was not fully settled by the end. At home, ask Ananya to classify three changes and state the evidence for each.

skills.skill: Define a physical change (no new substance; only shape, size or state changes) and give examples
Define a chemical change (a new substance with new properties forms) and recognise its signs: gas, colour change, heat or light, new smell, new solid
Classify everyday changes using evidence, knowing that 'can it be reversed?' is a clue but not the rule

turns.text: dono bas mix hue... haldi powder aate mein ghul gaya, par naya substance nahi bana... waise hi jaise main apne drawing water mein poster colour mix karti hoon, paani ka colour change hota hai but wo paani hi rehta hai... par ek baar maine butter paper pe drop kiya toh alag sa laga

Haan, haldi aur aata mix hue; rang badalna akela chemical change ka proof nahi. Poster colour wale paani mein bhi colour mix hota hai, lekin mixture sirf paani nahi rehta. Butter paper par drop se kya alag laga, zara bataiye?
butter paper pe oily sa laga... jaise alag feel hua... par dikhao na aluminium sheet ka dhakkan kaise banta hai? dikhao dikhao
Butter paper par oily feel hua, samjhi. Dabane ke baad aluminium hi rehta hai ya nayi substance banti hai?
physical change hai na... wahi aluminium hai, bas shape change hui... lekin mujhe dekhna hai yeh kaise karte hain asli mein, workshop ka photo dikhao na

Haan, sheet ko dabane se shape badli, aluminium wahi raha. Asli workshop ki photo banwa rahi hoon; tab tak sochiye, sheet ko ek dhakkan ke mould par dabaya jaata hai. Ab wax pighalne aur mombatti ki baati jalne mein kaunsa physical, kaunsa chemical hai, aur kya saboot hai?

wax pighalna toh physical hai... solid se liquid hota hai, jaise ice cream... par baati jalna, wo chemical hai na? kyunki fire aata hai aur light bhi... par saboot kya hota hai, main bhool jaati hoon... ek baar humari Diwali mein diya jala tha toh smell aayi thi, wo baati ka smell tha kya?

Haan, wax ke liye aapne state badalne ka reason diya. Baati jalne par light aur smell sanket ho sakte hain, par diya ki smell sirf baati se thi, yeh pakka nahi; tel ya ghee bhi jal raha hota hai. Jalne ke baad baati par jo kaala residue dikhta hai, woh pehle wali baati se kaise alag hai?

haan didi, kaala residue bilkul alag hota hai, wo hard aur black sa... pehle baati soft thi aur white thi, ab jalne ke baad ekdum alag cheez ban gayi, jaise naya substance. toh ye chemical change ka saboot hai. par mujhe samajh nahi aata, agar wax ko dubara thanda kar dein toh solid ban jaata hai, toh kya hamesha reversible change physical hota hai? jaise dahi bana do toh wapas doodh ho sakta hai

Baati ka soft se kaala residue banna nayi substance ka achha saboot hai; wax ke liye aapne sirf state badalna bataya. Dahi ko wapas doodh nahi bana sakte, par kaagaz phaadna bhi ulta nahi hota aur phir bhi physical change hai. Toh kaagaz phaadna physical kyon hai?

kyunki... matlab kaagaz phaadne se naya substance nahi banta na, bas chhote tukde ho jaate hain... kaagaz wahi rehta hai, bas shape chhoti... par dahi ka kya, wo toh naya substance hai, isiliye wapas nahi ho sakta. lekin mujhe toh lagta tha sab kuch wapas ho sakta hai agar thanda kar do, jaise melted chocolate fridge mein rakh do toh solid ban jaati hai... toh dahi bhi?

Haan, kaagaz ke tukdon mein bhi kaagaz hi rehta hai; isliye phaadna physical change hai. Aap soch rahi hain ki chocolate ki tarah dahi bhi thandi karke doodh ban jayega. Chocolate thandi hokar phir solid hoti hai, par dahi mein doodh se alag substance ban chuka hai; fridge use wapas doodh nahi banata. Agar doodh garmi mein khatta hokar phat jaaye, toh woh physical hai ya chemical, aur kya saboot hai?
chemical hoga... kyunki doodh ka taste khatta ho gaya aur smell bhi badal gayi na... par dikhao na, khatta doodh ka photo dikhao, kaise phat jaata hai

Chemical badlav ka aur saboot hai ki doodh phatkar naye dane aur alag paani jaisa hissa banata hai; sirf thanda karne se woh doodh nahi banta. Phate doodh ki tasveer banwa rahi hoon; tab tak sochiye, usmein chhote dane aur alag paani jaisa hissa kaisa dikhega?

chhote dane matlab jaise doodh mein se white white tukde alag ho gaye hote hain, aur paani jaise greenish paani rehta hai... meri dadi boli thi wo paani healthy nahi hota, par maine toh kabhi photo mein dekha nahi, dikhao na pls? aaj subah mummy ne chai banayi thi aur doodh phat gaya tha, mummy ne bola 'ab iska paneer banayenge', lekin mujhe laga fridge mein rakh do toh theek hoga

Haan, phate doodh mein safed dane aur halka peela-hara paani alag dikh sakta hai. Chai ka phata doodh fridge mein thanda hoga, par phir se doodh nahi banega, kyunki naye dane ban chuke hain. Chaliye, ab ek alag example se check karein: poster kaatne aur sparkler jalne mein chemical change kaunsa hai, aur kya sirf wapas na bana paana kaafi saboot hai?

sparkler jalna chemical change hai na... kyunki light aati hai, chingariyaan nikalti hain, aur smell bhi aati hai... poster kaatna toh bas kaagaz ke tukde hai, jaise main apni drawings ko scissors se kaatti hoon... par didi, aapne kaha reversibility se zyada zaroori saboot kya hai... matlab sparkler mein naya substance banta hai? kaala powder sa jo girta hai?

Haan, sparkler jalna chemical change hai: chingari aur light sanket hain, aur baad ka kaala residue naya substance banne ka saboot ho sakta hai. Poster ke tukde kaagaz hi rehte hain, chahe unhe wapas jodna mushkil ho. Asli farq yahi hai ki naya substance bana ya nahi. Kitchen mein mithai banate waqt ek physical aur ek chemical badlav kaunsa ho sakta hai?

socho socho... mithai ban rahi hai... haan, sugar pighalna, wo toh physical hoga na, solid se liquid? lekin wo chashni mein tabdeel ho jaati hai, toh wo alag hai kya? aur mummy ghee garam karti hain, wo bhi pighalta hai... chemical change kya hoga? kuch jalne jaisa? par mithai mein toh jalate nahi hain... ya phir doodh ka khoya banana, wo chemical hai kyunki naya taste aur smell aata hai? didi, sa

Haan, ghee garam hokar pighalta hai toh physical change hai. Cheeni chashni mein ghulti hai, pighalti nahi; aur doodh se khoya banana chemical change ka example ho sakta hai, kyunki uski properties badalti hain. Mithai banne mein ek physical aur ek chemical badlav aap kaunse chunengi?

okay so... ghee garam hona, wo toh physical hai, kyunki solid se liquid hua, bas state change... aur doodh ka khoya banana chemical hoga na, kyunki usmein pura taste aur texture badalta hai, jaise dadi ka khoya makhana... par mujhe khoya bante hue kabhi nahi dikha, ek baar photo dikhao na khoya banate hue, kaise kadhai mein doodh se solid ban jaata hai...

Haan, ghee ka solid se liquid hona physical badlav hai. Khoya mein taste aur texture badalte hain, lekin sirf gaadha ya solid dikhna naye substance ka pakka saboot nahi. Khoya bante hue ki tasveer banwa rahi hoon; tab tak imagine kijiye, kadhai ka doodh garam hote hote gaadha hota hai aur hilaane par neeche jamne lagta hai. Tasveer aane tak, cheeni paani mein ghule toh woh pighal rahi hai ya ghul rahi hai?

namak paani mein ghulta hai didi... pighalna nahi, pighalna toh jaise ice cream dhoop mein... wo bas liquid ban jaati hai, ismein kuch alag nahi banta, par namak toh paani mein gayab ho jaata hai na? dikhta nahi, par taste karta hoon toh namkeen lagta hai, matlab wo hai toh sahi andar kahin... chhupa hua hai. mummy kehti hain namak dissolve ho gaya, toh ghulna aur pighalna different hain

Haan, sahi shabd ghulna hai. Namak paani mein dikhta nahi, par namkeen taste batata hai ki woh ab bhi wahin hai; pighalne mein ice cream bina paani mein mile liquid hoti hai. Agar namak ghule paani ko taraazu par tolein, toh namak milane ke baad wazan badhega, utna hi rahega ya ghatega?
